description: This Java source file defines a custom BeanSerializerModifier for Jackson serialization, specifically modifying how LocalDate objects are serialized based on the presence of a specific annotation. It customizes serialization behavior for LocalDate fields in Java beans within the Fineract project.

classes.name: JacksonLocalDateBeanSerializerModifier
classes.description: A custom BeanSerializerModifier that replaces the serializer for LocalDate fields with a custom serializer, either a standard LocalDate serializer or an array serializer depending on the presence of a specific annotation.

methods.name: changeProperties
methods.description: Overrides the method to assign a custom serializer to LocalDate properties, selecting between a single date serializer and an array serializer based on the bean's annotation.

methods.name: assignLocalDateSerializer
methods.description: Helper method to assign a specified serializer to all bean properties of type LocalDate.
